summary: CooperCompanies filed an 8-K reporting fiscal Q3 2026 results (quarter ended July 31, 2026) and disclosing completion of its previously announced strategic review alongside an increased share repurchase authorization. The combination of review completion and larger repurchase authorization suggests a capital-returns pivot rather than a sale; watch for buyback size and any strategic actions in the attached Exhibit 99.2.
